document.name: Dialogues with Books: Monthly Meetup
document.short_description:
Join Bangalore`s Iconic Book Community - Monthly DWB Meetup! 📚

Join Dialogues with Books (DWB) for our monthly gathering where fellow bibliophiles come together to celebrate the joy of reading!

What We`ll Do -

Come with a book you`ve been enjoying lately - any genre welcome! We`ll all share what we`re reading, why it resonates with us, and dive into lively discussions about the stories and ideas that captivate us. Feel free to read favourite passages aloud and discover your next great read through fellow bibliophiles` recommendations.

Expect an evening of engaging book conversations over warm beverages, light snacks, and great company!

About DWB - Dialogues with Books is one of Bangalore`s oldest book communities, creating a vibrant, inclusive space where literature lovers share their passion and form lasting friendships through books. Whether you`re a seasoned reader or looking to reconnect with reading, you`ll find a warm welcome here.

DWB is Perfect For: Book enthusiasts, readers wanting to discover new genres, and anyone seeking thoughtful literary conversations in Bangalore`s vibrant reading community.

Location: Dialogues Koramangala

Meet Your Host: Bharat - Bharat is an avid reader, writer, and passionate bibliophile with eclectic literary tastes spanning classics, fiction, philosophy, poetry, and self-improvement. His favorite authors include Hemingway, Murakami, Mishima, P.G. Wodehouse, and Edgar Allan Poe. 

His infectious enthusiasm for books and skill at facilitating discussions makes every meetup both stimulating and enjoyable.

document.name: Kalighat Painting Workshop
document.short_description:
KALIGHAT PAINTINGS – WHERE TRADITION MEETS MODERNITY

Bengal is renowned for its rich cultural heritage and diverse artistic traditions, including music, literature, dance, and visual arts. In this workshop, we will explore one of Bengal's most fascinating and thought-provoking art forms—Kalighat Paintings.

Bold, expressive & vibrant, Kalighat paintings beautifully bring together a variety of themes, ranging from Hindu mythology and spirituality to secular life and social commentary.

Originating in 19th-century Kolkata during the colonial period, this distinctive art form developed around the Kalighat Temple, dedicated to Goddess Kali. The paintings were traditionally created on patas (cloth or paper scrolls) by artists known as Patuas. Located near the banks of the Hooghly River and the popular Kalighat Temple, the area attracted pilgrims, locals, and foreign visitors, creating a thriving audience for these unique artworks.

However, with the growing popularity of printed reproductions in the early 20th century, traditional handmade Kalighat paintings gradually declined.

The legacy of this expressive art form was later reinterpreted and celebrated by renowned Indian artist Jamini Roy, who drew inspiration from Bengal's folk traditions and brought a distinctive modern interpretation to traditional Indian art.

What will you learn?

Learn about the history and evolution of Kalighat Paintings

Explore the life and artistic journey of Jamini Roy

Understand the distinctive themes, styles, and visual language of this art form

Discover how traditional Indian folk art influenced modern artistic expression

Create your very own Kalighat-inspired painting

This will be a wonderful opportunity to experience Indian art and culture through storytelling, learning, and hands-on creativity!

Note:

All art materials required for the workshop will be provided by the host.

What will you take home?

A Detailed Hands-On Workshop Workbook

Knowledge & History of Kalighat art & culture

Your very own completed artwork created during the workshop

What do you need to bring?

A water bottle to keep yourself hydrated.

All workshop materials will be provided. However, if preferred, you may bring an examination pad or paper board for additional support while working.

Please Note

Kindly be on time, Participants arriving late may miss the storytelling and introduction to the history of this beautiful art form.

No refunds will be provided for cancellations.

Come, explore the vibrant world of Kalighat Paintings, where storytelling, tradition, culture, and creativity come together & take home a beautiful piece of art created by you!

document.name: Design Thinking for Teens
document.short_description:
🚀 DESIGN THINKING — MADE FOR TEENS

For the first time, Vishal Mimani is creating a Design Thinking workshop exclusively for teenagers.

And this is not about sitting through a 6.5-hour lecture.

Through real-world case studies, hands-on challenges and collaborative exercises, teens will actually experience Design Thinking; a globally recognised methodology used to solve complex problems creatively.

🌟 What will teens actually gain?

💡 Think beyond the obvious:

Learn how to look at a problem from different perspectives instead of jumping to the first solution.

🧩 Become a better problem-solver:

Break down messy, real-life problems into manageable parts and find creative ways forward.

🎯 Turn ideas into solutions:

Learn how to move from “I have an idea” to testing, improving and building a solution that people actually need.

🗣️ Communicate ideas with confidence:

Practise presenting thoughts, explaining why an idea works and getting comfortable sharing opinions.

🤝 Collaborate with different people:

Work in teams, listen to different viewpoints, handle disagreements and build on each other’s ideas.

🔍 Develop empathy & observation skills:

Learn to understand what people really need, a skill that helps in everything from school projects to relationships to future careers.

⚡ Get comfortable with experimentation:

Discover that getting something wrong isn't failure it’s often how better ideas emerge.

🌱 Build a mindset useful beyond school

Design Thinking helps develop creativity, curiosity, adaptability, critical thinking and initiative; skills that matter in college, careers, entrepreneurship and everyday life.

And they won’t leave empty handed. 😄

🥪 Snacks, beverages & lunch

📒 A Design Thinking workbook to take home

🏅 Participation certificate

💡 A hands-on experience they can actually talk about and apply

📅 Choose your Sunday:

📍 Indiranagar, Bangalore

💰 ₹3,200 per teen

👥 Limited seats

If your teen is curious, creative, enjoys solving problems, wants to become a better communicator, or simply wants to learn a skill that isn't taught in a typical classroom this workshop is for them.

Come curious. Leave thinking differently.
